title: helianthemum tuberaria var. alpestre
intro: Helianthemum tuberaria var. alpestre, commonly known as alpine rockrose, is a plant species that belongs to the family Cistaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of alpine rockrose include soothing and calming effects, which may help alleviate anxiety, insomnia, and other stress-related issues. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is necessary to confirm its efficacy and potential uses.
